entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I wonder if all that Medjed[n]business was just a prank.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Now that I think about it calmly,[n]it's strange that they haven't[n]actually done anything yet.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If their goal is to target the[n]Phantom Thieves, they should want[n]to be acting now, given our fame.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh. When you put it that way,[n]it kinda makes me wonder too.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Especially after they taunted[n]us theatrically like that.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes. However, it would be[n]best for us to come up with a[n]countermeasure regardless.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: For now though, we should[n]cautiously enjoy the sushi.[n]That is all we can do.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I was thinking that too! I can't[n]really put it into words though.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm sorry for bringing this[n]up. On the day before our[n]celebration party too...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Cheer up, Makoto! We'll be eating[n]sushi like kings tomorrow!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I hope one person in particular[n]is on their best behavior. I'll[n]refrain from saying who though.
